issuing_authority.value: Georgia State Board of Architects and Interior Designers
issuing_authority.quote: The Georgia State Board of Architects and Interior Designers shall grant certificates and administer the provisions of this article, and the board shall keep a registry of registered interior designers.

required.quote: Each applicant for certification as a registered interior designer shall meet the following requirements: (1) Is at least 21 years of age; (2) Has submitted a completed application as required by the board; (3) Has submitted the fees required by the board; (4) Provides proof of having passed the examination promulgated by the National Council for Interior Design Qualification or an examination approved by the board; and (5) Except as otherwise provided in subsection (c) of this Code section, provides proof that the applicant has acquired a minimum four-year degree

experience_source.quote: Each applicant for certification as a registered interior designer shall meet the following requirements: (1) Is at least 21 years of age; (2) Has submitted a completed application as required by the board; (3) Has submitted the fees required by the board; (4) Provides proof of having passed the examination promulgated by the National Council for Interior Design Qualification or an examination approved by the board; and (5) Except as otherwise provided in subsection (c) of this Code section, provides proof that the applicant has acquired a minimum four-year degree

exams.notes: Or an examination approved by the board
exams.quote: Provides proof of having passed the examination promulgated by the National Council for Interior Design Qualification or an examination approved by the board

interval_years.quote: A certificate of registration as a registered interior designer shall be valid for two years and shall be renewed biennially.

required.quote: An applicant for renewal of a certificate of registration shall pay a renewal fee and shall meet such continuing education requirements as the board may require by rule or regulation.

hours_per_period.quote: The continuing education requirements shall not exceed 40 hours biennially.

period_years.quote: The continuing education requirements shall not exceed 40 hours biennially.

available.quote: Any person who has been certified or registered as an interior designer in another state or foreign country may be issued a certificate of registration by the board to use the title "registered interior designer," provided that such person demonstrates to the satisfaction of the board that he meets the requirements for registration in this state.

requirements.value: Must demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board that the applicant meets the requirements for registration in Georgia.
requirements.quote: provided that such person demonstrates to the satisfaction of the board that he meets the requirements for registration in this state

national_certification.quote: Provides proof of having passed the examination promulgated by the National Council for Interior Design Qualification or an examination approved by the board

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to use the title "registered interior designer" unless that person has been issued a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer as provided in this article.

credential_type.quote: Any person wishing to use the title "registered interior designer" shall apply to the board for a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer.

is_mandatory.quote: Nothing in this article shall be construed as prohibiting or restricting the practice or activities of an interior decorator or individual offering interior decorating services

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to use the title "registered interior designer" unless that person has been issued a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer as provided in this article.

scope_protection.quote: Nothing in this article shall be construed as prohibiting or restricting the practice or activities of an interior decorator or individual offering interior decorating services, including, but not limited to, selection of surface materials, window treatments, wall coverings, paint, floor coverings, and lighting fixtures.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed any fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed any fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed gross negligence, incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or recklessness in professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed any gross negligence, incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or recklessness in his or her professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of seal by a firm without complying with personal direction and supervision requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitted the use of his or her seal by any firm, partnership, limited liability company, or corporation without complying with the provisions of Code Section 43-4-10

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude, or entered plea of nolo contendere, or received first offender treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been convicted by any court of record of the United States of any act which would constitute a felony or a crime involving moral turpitude in this state or a plea of nolo contendere or the affording of first offender treatment to any such charge

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated this article or any rule, regulation, or standard of conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violated this article or any rule, regulation, or standard of conduct promulgated by the board pursuant to the powers conferred upon it by this article

definition_quote.value: Interior design means the rendering of or the offering to render designs, consultations, studies, planning, drawings, specifications, contract documents, or other technical submissions and the administration of interior construction and contracts relating to nonstructural interior construction of a building by a registered interior designer.
definition_quote.quote: "Interior design" means the rendering of or the offering to render designs, consultations, studies, planning, drawings, specifications, contract documents, or other technical submissions and the administration of interior construction and contracts relating to nonstructural interior construction of a building by a registered interior designer.

value: Space planning, finishes, furnishings, and design for fabrication of nonstructural interior construction within interior spaces of buildings
Life safety design of proposed or modification of existing nonstructural and nonengineered elements (partitions, doors, stairways, paths of egress)
Modification of existing building construction to alter number of persons for which egress systems are designed
Preparation of interior construction documents sealed and signed for building permit approval
methods_authorized.quote: Space planning, finishes, furnishings, and the design for fabrication of nonstructural interior construction within interior spaces of buildings; Responsibility for life safety design of proposed or modification of existing nonstructural and nonengineered elements of construction such as partitions, doors, stairways, and paths of egress connecting to exits or exit ways; and Modification of existing building construction so as to alter the number of persons for which the egress systems of the building are designed.

credential_tier.quote: Any person wishing to use the title "registered interior designer" shall apply to the board for a certificate of registration as a registered interior designer.

ncidq_exam_required.quote: Provides proof of having passed the examination promulgated by the National Council for Interior Design Qualification or an examination approved by the board

nonstructural_scope_only.quote: "Nonstructural interior construction" means the construction of elements which do not include a load-bearing wall, a load-bearing column, or other load-bearing elements of a building essential to the structural integrity of the building.

value: Building shell systems (mechanical, plumbing, fire protection, electrical, structural, or motorized vertical transportation systems)
Fire-rated vertical shafts in multistory structures
excluded_building_systems.quote: The design of or responsibility for the building shell or any building shell systems; or Construction which materially affects building life safety systems pertaining to fire safety protection such as fire-rated vertical shafts in multistory structures and fire-rated protection of structural elements with the exception of incidental restoration of fire protection to elements impacted by nonstructural elements of construction, smoke evacuation, emergency sprinkler systems, and emergency alarm systems.

interior_decorator_exemption.quote: Nothing in this article shall be construed as prohibiting or restricting the practice or activities of an interior decorator or individual offering interior decorating services, including, but not limited to, selection of surface materials, window treatments, wall coverings, paint, floor coverings, and lighting fixtures.

permit_submission_authority.quote: "Interior construction document" means detailed drawings and specifications sealed and signed by a registered interior designer certifying compliance with applicable current building codes, ordinances, laws, and regulations that define the work to be constructed in such form as is required for approval of a construction permit by a building official or fire marshal.

seal_required.quote: A registered interior designer shall be authorized to have a seal separate from the seal of registered architects. The seal of a registered interior designer shall be applied to drawings or other documents prepared by or under the responsible control of the registered interior designer

seal_distinct_from_architect_seal.quote: A registered interior designer shall be authorized to have a seal separate from the seal of registered architects.

responsible_control_defined.quote: "Responsible control" means the amount of control over and detailed knowledge of the content of technical submissions during their preparation as is ordinarily exercised by registered or licensed professionals applying the required professional standard of care, as defined by rules and regulations adopted by the respective boards governing such professionals.

inactive_status_available.quote: The division director may provide for inactive status licenses for the various professional licensing boards.
